annotations.title: Add a position to my portfolio

description: Add a vault position by hand to YOUR OWN portfolio, as the "Add a vault position" form on /account/passport does: the vault (slug or contract address), the dollars put in and the date (today when omitted). Needs the API key of the account. The first 3 positions by hand are free to every account; more need a plan, and over the free ones without one the answer is a 402 with the plans that carry it and `detail.allowance` (used, freeLimit, says); nothing is written. One position per vault: a second deposit into the same vault is a move on that position, not a new one. Read the result with my_portfolio_positions.

amountUsd.description: The dollars put in, above zero.

enteredAt.description: The date put in, ISO (e.g. 2026-11-25). Omit for today.

vault.description: The vault slug or its contract address.

name: add_portfolio_position

allowance.description: The account’s positions by hand after this one: used, freeLimit, limit, hasPlan, canAdd, says.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
